references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.
Native species shape: gaunt human in a black robe holding a tall staff with a small flag-like ornament.
Shipped catalog humanoid/human: hooded blue-grey cloak with two knives. The Necromancer is a bare-headed robed staff-holder; also stay distinct from urkis (lightning) and celia (pale dress).

prompt_fields.subject: A gaunt bald human man with a pale drawn face in a long light slate-lavender robe with tattered hem and a high collar, standing upright and filling most of the disc height, one bone-pale hand raised in a casting gesture and the other holding a short twisted dark staff close to the body, its top no higher than a hand above his head. The figure is large and broad in the frame with the raised hand and staff well inside the inner four-fifths of the disc.
prompt_fields.contrast: Fifth humanoid/human catalog identity next to urkis (blue-grey robe with lightning), celia (pale tan dress and wooden staff), harno (hooded cloak with two knives) and the plain thief/rogue figures. The Necromancer is bare-headed and fully robed with a raised pale hand and a short dark staff; silhouette (bald head, long straight robe, raised hand) and value (mid-dark slate-violet robe with lifted lighter fold planes, bone-pale face and hand as the value break) separate it. The robe must never be near-black.
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at the style reference's own brightness, if anything a hair lighter, and never darker. No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures.
prompt_fields.palette: Light slate-lavender robe with pale grey-violet fold highlights and cream-grey ragged trim, clearly a mid-light value robe and never black or charcoal, bone-pale skin at the head and hand, dark brown staff with a small pale grey ornament; dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.
